title: Story Morning listening booth
passage: Welcome to Story Morning. If you want to use the listening booth today, please wait until the storyteller has finished in the main room. We leave the booth door open so that families can hear their names when we call them. If you want a quieter place while you wait, try the window seats upstairs. You can fill out a listening card there, but bring it downstairs when you’re ready. A blank card won’t hold a turn. Show it to the volunteer, who’ll write your name on the list. The headphones can stay in the booth. We wipe them between turns.
passageZh: 歡迎來到故事早晨。今天如果想用聆聽亭，請等主廳的講故事活動結束。我們會讓亭門開著，這樣叫名字時各個家庭聽得到。等候時若想找安靜一點的位置，不妨坐在樓上靠窗的位置。你們可以在那裡填聆聽卡，準備好之後再把卡帶下樓。空白卡不能保留順位。請把填好的卡出示給志工，他會把你們的名字寫在名單上。耳機可以留在亭子裡；每次換人前我們會擦拭。
